Token refresh interval script - Iz root direktorijuma projekta git bash (here):
./scripts/set-keycloak-access-token-lifespan.sh


Rate limiting:

const results = await Promise.all(
  Array.from({ length: 30 }, async (_, i) => {
    const response = await fetch("/api/users", {
      method: "GET",
      credentials: "include"
    });

    return {
      request: i + 1,
      status: response.status
    };
  })
);

console.table(results);

console.log(
  "429 odgovori:",
  results.filter(r => r.status === 429).length
);

Testiranje gateway-a:
1) za previse puta pogresan unos master lozinke master lozinka na network tab filtrirati decryption-failure i 6 puta pogresnu unjeti (obrisati u redisu poslije svakog testa block i decryption-failures)
2) za sumnjive korisnicke unose u network console: const probe = encodeURIComponent("' OR '1'='1");

for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
  const response = await fetch(
    `/api/users?search=${probe}`,
    {
      credentials: 'include',
      cache: 'no-store'
    }
  );

  console.log(
    `Pokušaj ${i}:`,
    response.status,
    response.headers.get('X-SecureVault-Block-Reason')
  );
}

nakon toga normalan zahtjev: const r = await fetch('/api/users', {
  credentials: 'include'
});

console.log(r.status);
console.log(r.headers.get('X-SecureVault-Block-Reason'));
3) za izmisljeni session cookie u powershell: 1..11 | ForEach-Object {
  curl.exe -s -o NUL -w "%{http_code}`n" `
    -H "Cookie: __Host-SVSESSION=not-a-real-session" `
    "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/users"
}
